extra.answer: 按口径“退款订单率 = 退款订单数 / 支付订单数”（order_performance 表，订单归属年度）对比：退款压力上升的只有平台电商，从 2024 年的 5.70%（5001 单中 285 单退款）升至 2025 年的 5.83%（6000 单中 350 单退款），上升 0.13 个百分点；退款压力下降的渠道有两个：线下门店从 2.66%（2936 单中 78 单）降至 2.33%（3515 单中 82 单），下降 0.33 个百分点，是改善最明显的渠道；自营商城从 6.37%（3893 单中 248 单）降至 6.17%（5042 单中 311 单），下降 0.20 个百分点。总体而言，自营商城仍是退款订单率最高的渠道（6%+），线下门店最低（2%+）；平台电商是唯一退款率走高的渠道，且单量增长 20%，值得重点关注。

sqls:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT
    channel,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN refunded_order ELSE 0 END) AS refunded_orders_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN refunded_order ELSE 0 END) AS refunded_orders_2025
  FROM order_performance
  WHERE order_year IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT
  channel,
  orders_2024,
  refunded_orders_2024,
  ROUND(100.0 * refunded_orders_2024 / orders_2024, 2) AS refund_rate_2024_pct,
  orders_2025,
  refunded_orders_2025,
  ROUND(100.0 * refunded_orders_2025 / orders_2025, 2) AS refund_rate_2025_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * refunded_orders_2025 / orders_2025 - 100.0 * refunded_orders_2024 / orders_2024, 2) AS delta_pp,
  ROUND((1.0 * refunded_orders_2025 / orders_2025 - 1.0 * refunded_orders_2024 / orders_2024) / NULLIF(1.0 * refunded_orders_2024 / orders_2024, 0), 4) AS relative_change,
  CASE
    WHEN 1.0 * refunded_orders_2025 / orders_2025 > 1.0 * refunded_orders_2024 / orders_2024 THEN '上升'
    WHEN 1.0 * refunded_orders_2025 / orders_2025 < 1.0 * refunded_orders_2024 / orders_2024 THEN '下降'
    ELSE '持平'
  END AS direction
FROM yearly
ORDER BY delta_pp DESC

extra.answer: 2025 年月度净营收（SUM(net_revenue_cents)，按订单归属）全年合计约 3793.3 万元，月均约 316.1 万元。走势上 1–5 月相对平稳（268.0万–298.3万元，2 月最低 267.97 万元），6 月跳升至 386.66 万元，7 月回落后 8–10 月缓步爬升（324.7万→334.5万元），11 月达到全年峰值 393.23 万元（订单 1799 单，也是全年最高单量），12 月回落至 324.65 万元。峰值出现在 2025-11，且明确对应大促：当月「双十一」活动贡献净营收约 228.59 万元，占全月 58.1%，剔除活动后常规净营收约 164.64 万元，明显低于全年月均，说明 11 月峰值几乎完全由双十一大促拉动。次峰 6 月同样对应「618」大促（活动贡献 273.69 万元，占 70.8%）。需要注意 11 月退款金额也偏高（约 22.84 万元），大促冲高营收的同时也带来了较高退款。

sqls:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT order_month, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS month_net_revenue_cents
  FROM order_performance
  WHERE order_year = 2025
  GROUP BY order_month
),
campaign AS (
  SELECT order_month, campaign_name, SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS campaign_net_revenue_cents
  FROM order_performance
  WHERE order_year = 2025
  GROUP BY order_month, campaign_name
)
SELECT
  m.order_month,
  m.month_net_revenue_cents,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY m.month_net_revenue_cents DESC) AS month_revenue_rank,
  CASE WHEN m.month_net_revenue_cents = MAX(m.month_net_revenue_cents) OVER () THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_peak_month,
  c.campaign_name,
  c.campaign_net_revenue_cents,
  ROUND(100.0 * c.campaign_net_revenue_cents / m.month_net_revenue_cents, 2) AS campaign_share_pct
FROM monthly m
JOIN campaign c ON c.order_month = m.order_month
ORDER BY m.month_net_revenue_cents DESC, c.campaign_net_revenue_cents DESC
